name: learn-english
description: Sparkle English - a zero-cost, privacy-first, fully open-source English learning platform for children aged 3+

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sparkle/shared && npm run build --workspace @sparkle/api && npm run build --workspace @sparkle/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sparkle/shared && npm run test --workspace @sparkle/api && npm run test --workspace @sparkle/web
scripts.assets: npm run assets:media && npm run assets:icons
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run postman:build
